## [1.36.1](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.36.1) (2026-11-21)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed downloads saving the 22-second MovieBox upgrade ad instead of the actual video. Built on v1.35.0 codebase (Patcher-Version: 1.9.0) — compatible with Dhrubo Patcher 1.30.0 (patcher 1.13.0). Telegram popup and coffee button preserved. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK.**
